newTerms.Sons of universe administration: Hijos de la administración del universo

forcedChoices.reason: "your nets" addresses David and his crew; plural keeps one form for both imperatives.
"master" here is David as Simon's employer, not a title of Jesus; lowercase and a plain word.

forcedChoices.choice: Exodus text in ustedes; Isaiah text in tú
forcedChoices.reason: The Exodus promise speaks to the people; the Isaiah text speaks to one addressee ("Arise and shine... your light").

forcedChoices.choice: «como un hijo de Israel... como un hijo de Dios»
forcedChoices.reason: Kept the English singular; Spanish forces masculine "hijo" for the generic "child".
Keeps both readings open: come out of the seizure, or the people's reading of a spirit told to come out.
Spanish "simpatía" mainly means likability, a false friend; "compasión" carries both English words.
"was" in the sense of came into being; "fue" matches the following "ES" and keeps the brevity.

forcedChoices.choice: tú after «No, Andrés» (Ve, prepara, prepárate, tu regreso)
forcedChoices.reason: Jesus addresses Andrew by name; "your return" can be singular or plural, and the address to one person decides it.
